eligibility: IMPLEMENT_NOW (conditional on the V4 calibration gate)

scope.notImplemented: ORIGINAL_FUTURES_REPLICATION (DATA_BLOCKED: futures chains, contract values, rolls, correlation groups, shorting)

exactRules.rule: TR = max(H-L, H-PDC, PDC-L); N = (19*PDN + TR)/20, seeded with the 20-day mean TR
buy one unit when price exceeds the prior 20-day high by one tick, intraday at the breakout, at the open on a gap
skip an S1 breakout if the last breakout (taken or not, long or short) was not a losing breakout; losing = price moved 2N against it before a profitable 10-day exit
exactRules.interpretation: LITERAL: a 10-day exit at a loss without a prior 2N adverse move is not a losing breakout (counted NON_LOSER). Path-consistent intrabar order (the level nearer to the open is hit first). An unresolved (open) previous breakout counts as not losing (source silent; conservative, fewer entries). A stop inside the hypothetical breakout bar does not resolve it (conservative for the filter; counted)

exactRules.rule: if an S1 breakout was skipped, enter at the 55-day breakout
exactRules.interpretation: exit of failsafe positions follows S1 (source silent; labelled interpretation, R15 TUR-F-FAILSAFE-55)

exactRules.rule: buy one unit one tick above the 55-day high; no filter
unit = 1 % of the notional account / N (dollar volatility per share = N)

notional account = equity at the first session of the year; each loss of 10 % of the current notional cuts it by 20 % (1M -> 0.8M -> 0.64M; thresholds 10 %, 18 %, 24.4 % ... of the year start); the cut holds until the year start is regained; at a 50 % yearly loss no new units (TUR-E-NOTIONAL-01)
add one unit every 1/2 N above the previous unit fill, up to 4 units, several per day possible
exactRules.interpretation: N for add spacing and stops = N at the initial entry (worked example in the source keeps N constant)

exactRules.rule: stop 2N below the last unit fill; adds raise the stop of all units to 2N below the newest unit
exit all units when price trades below the prior 10-day low
exit all units when price trades below the prior 20-day low
at most 4 units per market and 12 units per direction
simultaneous signals: buy the strongest first; strength = (close - close 3 months ago) / N
take every signal; no VU lifecycle (no proximity, expiry or cooldown)
no market-regime, index or fundamental filter

modalStrength: MANDATORY for every SOURCE rule (the source calls the system complete and mechanical; TUR-F-FUND-01, TUR-F-CONS-01)

entry.fill: max(open, trigger) on the trigger bar

stop: 2N below the newest unit fill (market fill before costs); all units
positionSizing: unit = 1 % of notional / N; adds every 1/2 N to 4 units

portfolioRules.ranking: (close - close 63 sessions ago)/N, ties by id

exceptions: failsafe 55 after a skipped S1 breakout
forbiddenVuAdditions: next-open entry instead of the intraday breakout

declaredDeviations.note: N updated daily (source: weekly sheet) - LOW deviation already declared in R15
year start = actual equity at first session (Dennis set it subjectively)
6/10-unit correlated-group limits not applied: no point-in-time industry data (DATA_PARTIAL); TUR-E-CORR-01
3 months = 63 sessions; ties by security id
declared: net long beta; not the original risk profile
with 1 %/N units only a few units fit; declared
equities instead of ~20 futures; universe numbers are the frozen protocol, not source numbers
one tick = 0.01 in raw price, converted to the split-adjusted basis
measurement convention for daily bars; not externally calibrated (MEASUREMENT_PARTIAL)
frozen protocol costs: 10 bp slippage and 1 bp commission per side; gross variant reported separately
V4 measurement policy: stale limit, data events at last valid close, economic delisting scenarios; no entry on or after the terminal date
every fill, fee and dividend is written to a ledger that an independent replay (review/turtle-replay-v4.mjs) re-values daily; the run fails if the replay differs
